card_text: Mobile car fumigation and interior cleaning that comes to you.
From $118, island-wide, any day of the week.
lede: Cleanic Detailing is a mobile car fumigation and interior cleaning service run by Colin. The work is done where the car is parked, at an HDB, condo or office carpark across Singapore. Send your car model, location and what you noticed to 9108 6931 and you get advice on the right service before you book.

services.d: A short pest-control treatment of about one hour. It does not include steam cleaning.
The longer treatment for cockroach and other pest problems, about an hour and a half.
For stained seats, spills and pet hair. Most full interior jobs take one to two hours.
A scrub clean of seats and carpets for dirty or neglected interiors.
The source is found first, then the area is cleaned or treated.

price_note: A small surcharge may apply for multi-storey carparks, condos or landed properties. Final advice comes after you describe the problem.
service_area: Mobile service across Singapore. There is no shopfront: the work is done where your car is parked.
hours: 24 hours, including weekends and public holidays, subject to availability

faqs: Do you work at night and on weekends?
Yes, every day including public holidays, subject to availability. It is a 24-hour mobile service.
How much does car fumigation cost?
The MIRAKN Express package is $118 and takes about an hour, without steam cleaning. Full MIRAKN dry gas fumigation starts from $180 and takes about an hour and a half.
How much is interior cleaning and how long does it take?
Hot dry steam cleaning and shampoo scrub cleaning each start from $148. Most full interior jobs take one to two hours on site.
Do I need to bring my car to a workshop?
No. The work is done where the car is parked, at an HDB, condo, office or other accessible location in Singapore.
